headings.title: Legislative findings and purpose on antisemitism
headings.reviewNote: Sets forth legislative findings regarding equality and the purpose of addressing antisemitic discrimination and harassment in educational institutions.

headings.title: Definitions of antisemitism and educational institution
headings.reviewNote: Defines antisemitism using the International Holocaust Remembrance Alliance working definition and defines educational institution for postsecondary entities.

headings.title: Treatment of antisemitic harassment and discrimination
headings.reviewNote: Directs educational institutions to treat antisemitic harassment and discrimination in the same manner as discrimination motivated by race.

headings.title: Adoption of code policies and penalties
headings.reviewNote: Requires adoption of code of conduct policies defining antisemitism and penalties under Title VI civil rights standards.

headings.title: Scope of criticism of Israel and protections
headings.reviewNote: Specifies evaluation standards for criticism of Israel and protects First Amendment rights and federal and state discrimination laws.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes statutory policies, definitions, and code of conduct protections concerning antisemitism in public postsecondary educational institutions.

headings.title: Prohibition against discrimination in postsecondary education
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits discrimination based on race, ethnicity, origin, sex, disability, religion, or marital status against students and employees in public higher education.

headings.title: Non-restrictive program and course admission criteria
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits admission criteria that restrict access by protected classifications in programs or courses.

headings.title: Equal access to educational institution classes
headings.reviewNote: Guarantees class availability to all students without discrimination while preserving specialized disability or language programs.

headings.title: Equal availability of guidance and financial services
headings.reviewNote: Requires guidance, counseling, and financial aid services to be provided equally regardless of protected characteristics.

headings.title: Equal access to educational programs and activities
headings.reviewNote: Ensures all educational programs, activities, and opportunities are open without unlawful discrimination.

headings.title: First Amendment and discrimination law protections
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits public institutions from establishing or maintaining registries or databases identifying students based on protected religious or political views or activities.

headings.title: Reporting and investigation of antisemitic incidents
headings.reviewNote: Mandates an annual report to legislative committees before July first on campus free expression compliance and notes that original rolls cite subsection 3 whereas section 173.001 subsection 4 contains the policy adoption language.

entries.reviewSummary: Prohibits discrimination across public postsecondary institutions and establishes reporting and enforcement procedures for antisemitic complaints.

headings.title: Creation of Department of Higher Education
headings.reviewNote: Creates the Department of Higher Education and Workforce Development and transfers division functions under the Reorganization Act.

headings.title: Coordinating board powers and degree approvals
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the Coordinating Board for Higher Education, governing board composition, and statewide degree approval and dispute resolution authority.

headings.title: Advisory committee meetings and membership
headings.reviewNote: Requires the coordinating board to meet quarterly with an advisory committee composed of institutional heads from across Missouri.

headings.title: Transfer of colleges and universities to department
headings.reviewNote: Transfers the University of Missouri, Lincoln University, and state-governed institutions to the department by type III transfer.

headings.title: Transfer of State Historical Society to university
headings.reviewNote: Transfers the State Historical Society to the University of Missouri by type III transfer.

headings.title: Transfer of State Anatomical Board to department
headings.reviewNote: Transfers the State Anatomical Board to the department by type II transfer.

headings.title: Transfer of community college state aid functions
headings.reviewNote: Transfers community college supervision and state aid administration to the coordinating board while retaining vocational education in elementary and secondary education.

headings.title: Transfer of poultry experiment station to university
headings.reviewNote: Transfers the state poultry experiment station to the University of Missouri and abolishes prior poultry boards.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes the Department of Higher Education and Workforce Development and sets forth coordinating board governance and institutional transfers.

headings.title: Higher education resource website operation
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department to maintain a public website directing students to academic programs, financial aid, and credit transfer resources.

headings.title: Institutional reporting of higher education information
headings.reviewNote: Requires public institutions and vocational schools to report, and permits private institutions of higher education to report, the required career and graduate outcomes data to the department.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority for higher education website
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes department rulemaking to administer the higher education resource website under chapter 536.

entries.reviewSummary: Directs the department to operate a higher education resource website and mandates institutional information reporting.

headings.title: Appropriation requests for out-of-state or private contracts
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes coordinating board appropriation requests to contract with independent or out-of-state institutions to meet unmet workforce or research needs.

headings.title: Institutional eligibility requirements for instructional contracts
headings.reviewNote: Sets eligibility requirements for contracting independent or out-of-state institutions.

headings.title: Authority to develop new public degree programs
headings.reviewNote: Affirms the coordinating board's authority to approve new instructional programs at public colleges or universities.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes contracts with independent or out-of-state institutions for educational and research programs and preserves public degree program authority.

headings.title: Senior citizen tuition exemption scholarship
headings.reviewNote: Awards tuition exemption scholarships to qualified Missouri residents aged sixty-five and older at state educational institutions.

headings.title: Institutional certification and eligibility determination
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes institutions to determine entrance qualifications and certification of eligibility for senior tuition benefits.

headings.title: Class space limits on tuition benefits
headings.reviewNote: Allows institutions to limit senior tuition benefits based on available class space after paying students enroll.

headings.title: Termination of tuition benefit eligibility
headings.reviewNote: Provides for termination of tuition benefits if a recipient is determined to no longer meet eligibility requirements.

headings.title: Noncredit enrollment and course prerequisite requirements
headings.reviewNote: Requires senior tuition scholarship courses to be taken on a noncredit basis subject to prerequisites.

headings.title: Permissible registration fee limitation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes state institutions to charge a registration fee not exceeding twenty-five dollars per semester for senior scholarship recipients.

entries.reviewSummary: Provides tuition-free noncredit course scholarships for Missouri senior citizens at state educational institutions.

headings.title: Annual submission of tuition percentage change
headings.reviewNote: Requires public institutions to report proposed annual percentage changes in tuition to the coordinating board by July first.

headings.title: Tuition limits for institutions above average
headings.reviewNote: Restricts tuition increases for institutions above average tuition to the consumer price index plus limited state appropriation offset percentages.

headings.title: Tuition limits for institutions below average
headings.reviewNote: Limits dollar increases in tuition for institutions below average tuition based on consumer price index calculations.

headings.title: Applicability of penalty for excessive tuition
headings.reviewNote: Subjects institutions that exceed tuition limits without a waiver to a five percent state appropriation reduction or required fee refunds to students.

headings.title: Remission of operating support and waiver appeals
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes five percent operating support penalty remissions and appeal procedures before the commissioner and coordinating board.

headings.title: Application to community colleges
headings.reviewNote: Limits applicability of tuition increase limitations to community college out-of-district resident tuition above average tuition.

headings.title: Definitions regarding tuition calculation
headings.reviewNote: Defines average tuition, consumer price index, state appropriation, tuition, state operating support, and net tuition revenue.

headings.title: Governing board authority over tuition and fees
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that statutory tuition limits do not usurp governing board authority to establish tuition and fees.

headings.title: Expiration of tuition limitation provisions
headings.reviewNote: Sunsets tuition increase limitations for approved public institutions and community colleges starting July 1, 2022.

headings.title: Differentiated tuition and course fee requirements
headings.reviewNote: Governs implementation of differentiated tuition and elimination of required course fees upon departmental notification.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes tuition limitation formulas, penalty remittance procedures, appeal mechanisms, and differentiated tuition rules for public higher education institutions.

headings.title: Rules for online posting of faculty rosters and schedules
headings.reviewNote: Directs the coordinating board to promulgate rules requiring public institutions to post on their websites teaching faculty names, academic credentials links, student ratings where feasible, and course schedules identifying assigned instructors and teaching assistants.

headings.title: Provision of employment and earnings information
headings.reviewNote: Specifies employment rates, average earnings, graduation timeframes, and estimated costs to be jointly provided by the board and economic development department.

headings.title: Website and course catalog publication deadline
headings.reviewNote: Requires institutions to publish credential outcome and cost data on public websites and course catalogs by October 1, 2019.

headings.title: Institutional duty to publish credential information
headings.reviewNote: Mandates that public institutions ensure website and course catalog disclosure of credential outcome data.

entries.reviewSummary: Directs the coordinating board to adopt rules requiring public institutions to publish teaching faculty rosters, academic credentials links, student ratings where feasible, and instructor course schedules online.

headings.title: Institutional performance measures and job placement metric
headings.reviewNote: Directs the board to establish institutional performance funding measures including retention, graduation, and job placement, except job placement may not be used in any year the state unemployment rate increased from the prior calendar year.

headings.title: Triennial evaluation of institutional performance measures
headings.reviewNote: Directs the coordinating board to evaluate and revise institutional performance measures every three years.

headings.title: Department reporting on performance funding effectiveness
headings.reviewNote: Tasks the department with evaluating performance funding effectiveness and submitting quadrennial reports to legislative leadership and the governor.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes institutional performance measures, job placement metrics, and periodic reporting requirements for performance funding.

headings.title: Student loan program policies and department administration
headings.reviewNote: Directs the coordinating board to determine basic student loan policies and promulgate rules encouraging lender participation in the guaranteed student loan program.

headings.title: Submission of federal student loan program reports
headings.reviewNote: Requires student loan program federal reports to be submitted to the office of administration and legislative appropriations committees.

entries.reviewSummary: Sets policy, administration, and federal reporting requirements for the state student loan program.

headings.title: Issuance of student loan certificates of guarantee
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the department to issue guarantee certificates for eligible student loans, pay lenders upon default, and exercise subrogation rights.

headings.title: Special loan insurance premium assessment
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to charge borrowers a special loan insurance premium established by federal law to pay administration and guarantee costs.

headings.title: Authority to originate student loans
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the department to originate loans including lender of last resort loans from dedicated revolving funds.

headings.title: Actuarial limitation on total guaranteed loans
headings.reviewNote: Limits total outstanding guaranteed loans to amounts determinable by the state auditor based on sound actuarial judgment.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes student loan guarantees, insurance premiums, loan origination, and actuarial solvency limitations.

headings.title: Definitions for Access Missouri financial assistance
headings.reviewNote: Defines academic year, approved institutions, board, department, financial assistance, financial need, full-time student, student aid index, and related Access Missouri terms; source notes that referenced section 173.205 was repealed by S.B. 389, 2007.

headings.title: Compliance requirements for approved virtual institutions
headings.reviewNote: Precludes student eligibility for Access Missouri financial assistance if an approved virtual institution fails to continuously meet statutory criteria.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes institutional definitions and virtual institution compliance requirements for Access Missouri financial assistance.

headings.title: Administrative authority and program rulemaking
headings.reviewNote: Designates the coordinating board as the administrative agency and directs it to promulgate rules, prescribe application procedures, determine eligibility, and select recipients.

headings.title: Renewal eligibility and tax return verification
headings.reviewNote: Governs renewal evaluations and authorizes consent forms to verify applicant and parental financial records with state income tax returns.

headings.title: Creation of Access Missouri Financial Assistance Fund
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the dedicated nonreverting Access Missouri Financial Assistance Fund in the state treasury.

entries.reviewSummary: Designates program administration, tax verification procedures, and the Access Missouri Financial Assistance Fund.

headings.title: Applicant financial assistance eligibility criteria
headings.reviewNote: Establishes eligibility criteria requiring U.S. citizenship or permanent residency, Missouri residency, full-time undergraduate enrollment at an approved institution, and non-enrollment in a theology or divinity degree program.

headings.title: Ineligibility resulting from criminal offenses
headings.reviewNote: Disqualifies applicants convicted of or pleading guilty to felony or controlled substance offenses, provided the offense would disqualify the applicant from federal student aid under Title IV of the Higher Education Act of 1965, as amended.

headings.title: Duration of assistance and renewal standards
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that transfer students and continuing recipients who previously met section 173.215 criteria remain eligible; source notes section 173.215 was repealed by S.B. 389, 2007.

entries.reviewSummary: Sets individual eligibility standards, criminal disqualifications, semester limits, and renewal GPA criteria for Access Missouri assistance.

headings.title: Undergraduate award minimum and maximum amounts
headings.reviewNote: Establishes statutory schedules of minimum and maximum award amounts across public two-year, public four-year, private, and virtual sectors.

headings.title: Student aid index award adjustments
headings.reviewNote: Regulates award reductions based on student aid index brackets and requires deductions for A+ schools program payments.

headings.title: Funding shortfall and surplus distribution rules
headings.reviewNote: Provides proportional award reductions during funding shortfalls and directs excess appropriations toward expanding recipient numbers.

headings.title: Inflation adjustments and legislative appropriation reports
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes triennial inflation adjustments tied to the consumer price index subject to legislative appropriations and reports.

entries.reviewSummary: Prescribes award amounts, need-based adjustments, funding shortfall procedures, and inflation allowances for Access Missouri.

headings.title: Prohibition on benefits to unlawfully present students
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits awarding postsecondary education public benefits to students unlawfully present in the United States and mandates citizenship verification.

headings.title: Acceptable documentation of lawful presence
headings.reviewNote: Specifies permissible hard copy or electronic documentation proving United States citizenship or lawful presence.

headings.title: Annual institutional certification of compliance
headings.reviewNote: Requires all postsecondary institutions to certify annually that they have not knowingly awarded public benefits to unlawfully present students.

headings.title: Definitions of covered student and public benefit
headings.reviewNote: Defines covered student and postsecondary education public benefit for statutory verification requirements.

entries.reviewSummary: Restricts postsecondary education public benefits to lawfully present students and mandates annual institutional certification.

headings.title: Issuance of earnings withholding order for debt
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the department to issue earnings withholding orders to employers after paying defaulted student loan losses.

headings.title: Service of claim notice on borrower
headings.reviewNote: Requires service of a statement of claim and statutory explanation of rights on defaulting borrowers before initiating deductions.

headings.title: Borrower inspection and copying of loan records
headings.reviewNote: Guarantees borrowers an opportunity to inspect and copy records related to defaulted loans.

headings.title: Opportunity for written debt repayment agreement
headings.reviewNote: Provides defaulting borrowers an opportunity to enter into written debt repayment agreements with the department.

headings.title: Right to impartial contested case hearing
headings.reviewNote: Affords borrowers a hearing before an impartial hearing officer under chapter 536 contested case procedures and stays collection upon filing.

headings.title: Hearing officer written decision and repayment order
headings.reviewNote: Mandates written hearing decisions within sixty days and issuance of departmental debt repayment orders adopting findings.

headings.title: Failure to issue timely hearing decision
headings.reviewNote: Requires withdrawal of statement of claim if no decision issues within sixty days while preserving non-administrative legal remedies.

headings.title: Issuance of debt order upon default
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes issuance and service of an order to pay debt if a borrower fails to make a timely hearing request.

headings.title: Judicial review of debt payment order
headings.reviewNote: Allows borrowers to seek judicial review of departmental debt payment orders under administrative procedure statutes.

headings.title: Withholding of borrower earnings by employer
headings.reviewNote: Directs employers to withhold specified amounts up to a ten percent earnings limit upon issuance of an order to withhold.

headings.title: Legal effect and priority of withholding order
headings.reviewNote: Gives earnings withholding orders the legal force and effect of garnishments subject to child support priority provisions.

headings.title: Employer immunity and liability for noncompliance
headings.reviewNote: Grants employers immunity from borrower suits for compliance and imposes liability to the department for failure to withhold.

headings.title: Prohibition against employee discharge or discipline
headings.reviewNote: Makes it an infraction for an employer to discipline, discharge, or refuse to hire an employee due to an earnings withholding order.

headings.title: Service of process on borrower and employer
headings.reviewNote: Specifies methods of serving process and notices on borrowers and employers by appointed process servers or certified mail.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority for earnings withholding orders
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the board to promulgate rules governing hearing officer proceedings, department procedures, and employer withholding compliance.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes comprehensive administrative hearing, default order, and wage withholding procedures for recovering defaulted student loan debts.

headings.title: Resident status for separating military personnel
headings.reviewNote: Grants student resident status for admission and in-state tuition to individuals separating from the United States military with honorable or general discharges.

headings.title: Residency demonstration requirements for military personnel
headings.reviewNote: Requires separating service members to demonstrate physical presence and declare residency in Missouri or the community college taxing district.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority for military resident status
headings.reviewNote: Directs the coordinating board for higher education to promulgate rules implementing military student resident status.

headings.title: Definition of approved public institution
headings.reviewNote: Incorporates the definition of approved public institution from section 173.1102 for military residency provisions.

headings.title: Administrative rulemaking compliance and invalidity
headings.reviewNote: Governs the validity, nonseverability, and legislative review compliance of military resident status administrative rules.

entries.reviewSummary: Provides Missouri student resident tuition status for separating military service members and establishes rulemaking standards.

headings.title: In-state tuition for National Guard and reservists
headings.reviewNote: Deems active members of the Missouri National Guard and federal reserve components domiciled in Missouri for in-state tuition purposes.

headings.title: Demonstration of presence within state or district
headings.reviewNote: Requires military members to demonstrate presence within Missouri or the community college taxing district to receive in-state tuition.

headings.title: Application and reporting of other financial assistance
headings.reviewNote: Requires reporting other aid and applies tuition limitations only after all other financial assistance is applied up to attendance costs.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority for military in-state tuition
headings.reviewNote: Directs the coordinating board for higher education to promulgate rules implementing military in-state tuition.

headings.title: Definition of approved public institution
headings.reviewNote: Applies the definition of approved public institution set forth in section 173.1102.

headings.title: Administrative rulemaking compliance and invalidity
headings.reviewNote: Specifies statutory rulemaking procedures, nonseverability, and legislative review requirements under chapter 536.

entries.reviewSummary: Grants in-state tuition eligibility to Missouri National Guard and military reserve personnel and sets aid offset guidelines.

headings.title: Mandatory policy awarding credit for military training
headings.reviewNote: Requires the coordinating board to adopt a statewide policy mandating public institutions award academic credit for evaluated military training.

headings.title: Institutional adoption of military credit rules
headings.reviewNote: Mandates institutional adoption of rules and procedures implementing military credit awards and governs rulemaking validity under chapter 536.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates statewide policies and institutional rules for awarding higher education academic credit for military service and training.

headings.title: Establishment of State Guaranty Student Loan Fund
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the State Guaranty Student Loan Fund as a non-lapsing state fund consisting of appropriations, gifts, and grants.

headings.title: Deposit of loan default recoveries into fund
headings.reviewNote: Requires all recoveries for payments made on previously defaulted guaranteed loans to be credited promptly to the fund.

headings.title: Administration of fund by department
headings.reviewNote: Designates the department as the administrative agency for the State Guaranty Student Loan Fund.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes and governs administration and recovery deposits of the State Guaranty Student Loan Fund.

headings.title: Adoption of campus suicide prevention policies
headings.reviewNote: Requires public higher education institutions to develop policies covering crisis access, mental health services, outreach, and postvention.

headings.title: Staff and residence hall suicide intervention training
headings.reviewNote: Mandates campus procedures and training for identifying and assisting students exhibiting suicidal tendencies.

headings.title: Information on depression and suicide resources
headings.reviewNote: Directs institutions to provide all incoming students with resources concerning depression, suicide prevention, and support services.

headings.title: Website publication of suicide prevention information
headings.reviewNote: Requires suicide crisis intervention, mental health, and outreach materials to be published on institutional websites.

headings.title: Posting of free suicide prevention materials
headings.reviewNote: Mandates website publication of free-of-cost suicide prevention programs and materials by institutions and the department.

headings.title: Anonymous reporting methods for safety threats
headings.reviewNote: Requires institutions to maintain confidential anonymous reporting mechanisms for unsafe or dangerous activities.

headings.title: Printing suicide lifeline dialing code on identification
headings.reviewNote: Requires student identification cards to have the 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline dialing code printed on them.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates comprehensive campus suicide prevention policies, incoming student resources, anonymous threat reporting, and 988 identification card printing.

headings.title: Public governmental body status in higher education
headings.reviewNote: Specifies conditions under which entities in which institutions own equity are not considered public governmental bodies under sunshine laws.

headings.title: Construction of public body definition
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that the section does not broaden the statutory definition of public governmental body under section 610.010.

headings.title: Closed meetings for research and intellectual property
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes closed meetings and records regarding commercial intellectual property, research collaborations, and trade secrets.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs public governmental body status and closed records for university business collaborations and research intellectual property.

headings.title: Definitions of advanced placement and examinations
headings.reviewNote: Defines advanced placement examination, institution, and international baccalaureate examination for freshman course credit.

headings.title: Undergraduate credit policy for examination scores
headings.reviewNote: Requires public institutions to adopt policies awarding undergraduate course credit for AP scores of three or IB scores of four or higher.

headings.title: Pre-admission applicant credit evaluation notifications
headings.reviewNote: Directs institutions to determine and notify entering applicants upon request regarding applicable credit awards under the policy.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates public institutions adopt policies awarding undergraduate credit for qualifying AP and International Baccalaureate scores.

headings.title: School social work verification document authorization
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes accredited colleges and universities to issue state school social work verification documents to qualified graduates.

headings.title: Statewide form requirements for social work verification
headings.reviewNote: Requires institutions to provide reasonable accommodation for students with print disabilities; source notes original-roll variations ('upon request' and 'a' in S.B. 563).

headings.title: Institutional issuance of school social work document
headings.reviewNote: Directs publishers to furnish specialized instructional material formats upon institutional request; source notes original-roll variation ('he or she' in H.B. 1563).

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes accredited colleges and universities to issue official state school social work program verification documents.

headings.title: Title of College Credit Disclosure Act
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the statutory title of the section as the College Credit Disclosure Act.

headings.title: Non-accredited institution disclosure requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires non-regionally accredited institutions to disclose lack of regional accreditation during student admission application processes.

headings.title: Pre-registration student disclosure acknowledgment statement
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes exact fourteen-point font disclosure text regarding credit transferability and mandates signed student acknowledgment.

headings.title: Exemption for faith-related accredited institutions
headings.reviewNote: Exempts religious institutions accredited by national faith-related accrediting organizations recognized by the department of education.

entries.reviewSummary: Enacts the College Credit Disclosure Act requiring non-regionally accredited institutions to provide written transferability notices to enrolling students.

headings.title: Annual institutional budget requests and review
headings.reviewNote: Requires public four-year institutions to submit annual budget requests to the department for appropriation recommendations.

headings.title: Core funding increase allocation model adoption
headings.reviewNote: Governs cooperative development and coordinating board approval of the core funding increase allocation model.

headings.title: Establishment of institutional core funding baseline
headings.reviewNote: Establishes fiscal year 2015 appropriations as the core funding baseline for incorporating annual allocation model increases.

headings.title: Allocation parameters for core funding increases
headings.reviewNote: Establishes percentage parameters dedicating up to ten percent for funding inequities and at least ninety percent to performance funding.

headings.title: Department evaluation of allocation model effectiveness
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department to evaluate the increase allocation model and submit quadrennial reports to the governor and legislature.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes institutional budget request processes, baseline core funding levels, and the performance funding increase allocation model.

headings.title: Campus Free Expression Act and expressive rights
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the Campus Free Expression Act and protects noncommercial expressive activities on public higher education campuses.

headings.title: Campus outdoor areas deemed public forums
headings.reviewNote: Designates outdoor areas of public institution campuses as traditional public forums subject to reasonable content-neutral restrictions.

headings.title: Freedom of noncommercial expressive activity
headings.reviewNote: Allows students and campus community members to engage freely in outdoor expressive activity subject to subsection 2, provided conduct is lawful and does not materially and substantially disrupt institutional functioning.

headings.title: Right to student expression across campus
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that protections for outdoor campus expressive activity do not limit student expression rights elsewhere on campus.

headings.title: Civil causes of action to enjoin violations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes civil actions by the attorney general or aggrieved persons to enjoin violations and recover damages and fees.

headings.title: Statutory damages and penalties for violations
headings.reviewNote: Mandates court awards of at least five hundred dollars for initial violations plus fifty dollars for each day a violation continues.

headings.title: Statute of limitations and continuous accrual
headings.reviewNote: Establishes a one-year statute of limitations accruing anew each day an unlawful violation or policy persists.

entries.reviewSummary: Enacts the Campus Free Expression Act protecting outdoor campus speech as traditional public forums and establishing civil causes of action and statutory damages.

headings.title: Protections for belief-based student associations
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits public higher education institutions from taking adverse actions against student associations based on religious, political, or ideological beliefs.

headings.title: Legal remedies for aggrieved student associations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes aggrieved belief-based student associations to assert statutory violations as claims or defenses in judicial or administrative actions.

headings.title: Material and substantial disruption exception
headings.reviewNote: Exempts student associations from statutory protections where substantial evidence shows material and substantial disruption under Supreme Court precedent.

entries.reviewSummary: Protects belief-based student associations from adverse institutional action and provides judicial remedies while preserving campus disruption exceptions.

headings.title: Regulations for student loan agreement eligibility
headings.reviewNote: Directs the board to adopt regulations establishing standards for guaranteed loan terms, repayment, interest rates, defaults, and deferments.

headings.title: Non-discrimination standards for student loan eligibility
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits consideration of race, religion, sex, creed, color, residence, or choice of eligible institution in student loan eligibility.

entries.reviewSummary: Directs regulatory standards for guaranteed student loan agreements and mandates nondiscrimination in loan eligibility.

headings.title: Establishment of Lender of Last Resort Fund
headings.reviewNote: Creates the nonreverting Lender of Last Resort Revolving Fund in the state treasury consisting of federal funds, charges, gifts, and grants.

headings.title: Administration of fund by program
headings.reviewNote: Designates the student loan program as the administrative entity for the Lender of Last Resort Revolving Fund.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes and governs administration of the Lender of Last Resort Revolving Fund.

headings.title: Business donations to scholarship donation fund
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes business firms to donate to the Missouri Higher Education Scholarship Donation Fund and receive up to a fifty percent tax credit.

headings.title: Tax credit application, carryover, and transferability
headings.reviewNote: Regulates refundable tax credits, five-year carryover allowances, and provisions for selling or assigning earned credits.

headings.title: Effective tax year limitation on credits
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits applying tax credits authorized under the section against tax years beginning prior to January 1, 1995.

headings.title: Exclusive use of fund for scholarships
headings.reviewNote: Defines eligible institutions and related terms by reference to section 173.197; source notes that section 173.197 was repealed by S.B. 975 & 1024 Revision, 2018.

headings.title: Prohibition on tax credits after 2005
headings.reviewNote: Sunsets the issuance or authorization of tax credits under the section for all tax years beginning on or after January 1, 2005.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes business tax credits for donations to higher education scholarships and establishes transferability, carryover, and sunset rules.

headings.title: Memorandum of understanding with law enforcement
headings.reviewNote: Requires governing boards of public higher education institutions to enter into memoranda of understanding with local law enforcement regarding sexual assault and stalking.

headings.title: Policies, protocols, and jurisdiction for offenses
headings.reviewNote: Mandates detailed protocols on offense reporting, jurisdictional boundaries, and mandatory criteria for notifying law enforcement.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority for campus offense reporting
headings.reviewNote: Directs the coordinating board to promulgate rules under chapter 536 to administer the program, subject to the August 28, 2016 legislative-review nonseverability clause.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires public higher education institutions to execute memoranda of understanding with law enforcement for sexual assault and stalking protocols.

headings.title: Establishment of teacher scholarship program
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the Teacher Recruitment and Retention State Scholarship Program administered by the department of elementary and secondary education.

headings.title: Annual award amounts and scholarship limits
headings.reviewNote: Sets statutory caps on annual scholarship numbers, maximum award amounts up to UMC tuition rates, and student teaching reallocation rules.

headings.title: Definitions for teacher recruitment program
headings.reviewNote: Defines eligible student, hard-to-staff schools, and hard-to-staff subject areas for scholarship commitments.

headings.title: Consideration of financial need when applicants exceed funding
headings.reviewNote: Permits the Department of Elementary and Secondary Education to consider applicants' financial needs if the number of applicants exceeds available scholarships or revenues.

headings.title: Student qualification criteria for teacher scholarships
headings.reviewNote: Requires scholarship recipients to have completed two years at a community college (at least 48 credits, 2.5 GPA), an associate degree, five semesters at a four-year institution (at least 60 credits, 2.5 GPA), or a baccalaureate degree.

headings.title: Teaching commitment, loan conversion, and deferment
headings.reviewNote: Requires two years of teaching service per scholarship year, converts unmet awards to interest-bearing loans serviced by the loan authority, and authorizes deferments.

headings.title: Teacher recruitment and retention scholarship fund
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the nonreverting Teacher Recruitment and Retention State Scholarship Program Fund in the state treasury.

headings.title: Continued eligibility during qualifying school employment
headings.reviewNote: Maintains eligible student status as long as the recipient remains employed by the contracting school district despite status changes.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes the Teacher Recruitment and Retention State Scholarship Program, service commitment terms, loan conversion, and dedicated state fund.

headings.title: Definitions for military survivors grant program
headings.reviewNote: Defines eligible student, grant, institution of postsecondary education, qualifying military member, survivor, and tuition for survivor grants.

headings.title: Annual grant awards and academic standards
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes up to twenty-five annual survivor grants subject to maintaining a 2.5 cumulative GPA and allows quota expansions.

headings.title: Degree program enrollment and completion limitations
headings.reviewNote: Restricts grants to undergraduate certificate or degree programs and terminates eligibility upon completing a baccalaureate degree.

headings.title: Coordinating board rulemaking and application procedures
headings.reviewNote: Directs the coordinating board to promulgate rules and application procedures for military survivor grants.

headings.title: Administrative rulemaking compliance and invalidity
headings.reviewNote: Governs administrative rulemaking validity and legislative review requirements under chapter 536.

headings.title: Certification of eligibility by veterans commission
headings.reviewNote: Requires certification of survivor eligibility by the Missouri Veterans' Commission.

headings.title: Tuition, room, board, and book allowances
headings.reviewNote: Provides actual tuition coverage, room and board allowances up to two thousand dollars per semester, and up to five hundred dollars for books.

headings.title: Institutional transfer and refund remittance rules
headings.reviewNote: Allows institutional transfer without loss of entitlement and directs institutional refund remittances to the board upon student withdrawal.

headings.title: Reporting of other student aid awards
headings.reviewNote: Requires institutions and recipients to report all other financial assistance received to the coordinating board.

headings.title: Admission and degree completion disclaimer
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that grant awards do not guarantee admission, retention, or graduation at any postsecondary institution.

headings.title: Student eligibility and age limit criteria
headings.reviewNote: Allows eligible surviving children to apply for full benefits until age twenty-five.

headings.title: Exemption from sunset act provisions
headings.reviewNote: Exempts the military survivor grant section from the provisions of the Missouri Sunset Act.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes postsecondary educational grant allowances, qualifications, and administrative procedures for survivors of qualifying military members.

headings.title: Definitions for Vietnam veterans survivors grant
headings.reviewNote: Defines board, grant, institution of postsecondary education, survivor, tuition, and Vietnam veteran.

headings.title: Annual survivor grant awards and quota
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes up to twelve annual grants to survivors of Vietnam veterans and provides for waiting list extensions.

headings.title: Degree completion limits and tuition offset
headings.reviewNote: Limits grants to initial baccalaureate degree completion and caps benefits at total tuition costs.

headings.title: Coordinating board powers and administration
headings.reviewNote: Directs the board to establish performance standards, promulgate rules, and disburse tuition grants.

headings.title: Veterans service officer medical certification requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires eligibility certification by a state veterans service officer based on VA medical certification of toxic chemical exposure.

headings.title: Tuition grant amount calculation limits
headings.reviewNote: Establishes tuition grant amounts for Vietnam veteran survivors; source notes that the words 'section 174.030' appear in the original rolls.

headings.title: Institutional transfer and tuition refund provisions
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes transfer between approved institutions and requires refund remittances to the board upon student withdrawal.

headings.title: Reporting of other financial assistance received
headings.reviewNote: Requires reporting of all other student aid to the coordinating board.

headings.title: Admission and degree completion disclaimer
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that grants do not promise or guarantee institution admission, continued attendance, or degree attainment.

headings.title: Surviving children and spouses grant eligibility
headings.reviewNote: Sets eligibility age limits (under age 25 as of December 31, 1995 for children) and a five-year post-death enrollment window for surviving spouses.

headings.title: Statutory expiration date for survivor grants
headings.reviewNote: Provides that the Vietnam veteran survivors grant section expired on December 31, 2015.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes historical grant terms, eligibility certification, and expiration provisions for survivors of Vietnam veterans exposed to toxic chemicals.

headings.title: National Guard tuition waiver and grants
headings.reviewNote: Establishes undergraduate tuition and fee waivers for eligible Missouri National Guard members, provided the program is not implemented prior to the 2025-26 academic year.

headings.title: Assistance calculation and proration limits
headings.reviewNote: Calculates assistance based on actual tuition or University of Missouri average credit hour costs and authorizes proration.

headings.title: Application requirements and FAFSA submission
headings.reviewNote: Establishes semester application requirements, service certificates, 2.5 GPA standards, FAFSA submission, and prior military aid offsets.

headings.title: Grade point probation and assistance termination
headings.reviewNote: Provides academic probation for GPA drops below 2.5 and terminates assistance upon failure to regain good academic standing.

headings.title: Maximum credit hour limit for waiver
headings.reviewNote: Ceases tuition and fee waiver eligibility once a member completes one hundred twenty total credit hours.

headings.title: Appropriation threshold for tuition fee waiver
headings.reviewNote: Conditions waiver availability on state appropriations covering at least the previous fiscal year's percentage of total program costs.

headings.title: Termination of military affiliation and repayment
headings.reviewNote: Requires repayment of awarded or waived assistance if active military affiliation ceases during a term for non-medical reasons.

headings.title: Adjutant general administration of educational assistance
headings.reviewNote: Assigns program administration and equitable distribution guidelines to the office of the adjutant general.

entries.reviewSummary: Provides tuition waivers and grant assistance for Missouri National Guard members and sets academic, credit-hour, and military service retention rules.

headings.title: Minority environmental literacy scholarship program creation
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the Minority and Underrepresented Environmental Literacy Program within the department to award environmental scholarships.

headings.title: Establishment of recruitment and retention fund
headings.reviewNote: Creates the nonreverting Recruitment and Retention Scholarship Fund in the state treasury.

headings.title: Appropriation sources and deposit into fund
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes appropriations from general revenue, department fees, federal sources, gifts, and donations for the fund.

headings.title: Acceptance of grants, gifts, and donations
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to accept and administer public and private gifts and federal grants for scholarships.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority and administrative procedures
headings.reviewNote: Directs department rulemaking for qualifications, applications, deadlines, and award amounts under chapter 536.

headings.title: Eligible academic areas of environmental study
headings.reviewNote: Directs scholarships toward students in environmental engineering, environmental sciences, environmental chemistry, and environmental law enforcement.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes the Minority and Underrepresented Environmental Literacy Program, dedicated scholarship fund, and eligible degree fields.

headings.title: Attendance postponement for National Guard service
headings.reviewNote: Allows scholarship recipients to postpone attendance for up to two semesters to enter National Guard service without losing eligibility.

headings.title: Institutional notice and service verification requirements
headings.reviewNote: Requires advance institutional notification, commanding officer service certification, and compliance with general eligibility standards.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes scholarship recipients to postpone attendance for up to two semesters for Missouri National Guard service while retaining scholarship eligibility.

headings.title: Establishment of Higher Education Academic Scholarship
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the Higher Education Academic Scholarship Program to provide merit scholarships to eligible students.

headings.title: Statutory and program-specific definitions
headings.reviewNote: Applies section 173.1102 definitions and defines academic scholarship, ACT, approved institution, eligible student, Missouri test-takers, qualifying score (top five percent), recipient, renewal student, and SAT.

headings.title: Coordinating board administration and award selection
headings.reviewNote: Designates the coordinating board as the administrative agency with authority over rules, deferments, applications, and recipient selections.

headings.title: Academic scholarship award amounts and priority
headings.reviewNote: Establishes award amounts up to three thousand dollars for the top three percent and up to one thousand dollars for the fourth and fifth percentiles.

headings.title: Renewal eligibility for academic scholarship recipients
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes scholarship renewals for the second, third, and fourth years of postsecondary education upon maintaining compliance.

headings.title: Interruption of studies for public service
headings.reviewNote: Allows scholarship recipients to interrupt studies for up to twenty-seven months for public or nonprofit service, or six months after military service.

headings.title: Institutional transfer without loss of eligibility
headings.reviewNote: Permits academic scholarship recipients to transfer between approved institutions without losing scholarship eligibility.

headings.title: Refund remittances upon recipient institutional withdrawal
headings.reviewNote: Requires institutions to remit the scholarship share of refunds to the coordinating board upon recipient withdrawal.

headings.title: Postponement of enrollment for medical necessity
headings.reviewNote: Permits initial or renewal scholarship recipients to postpone enrollment for up to twenty-seven months due to illness, disability, pregnancy, or medical need.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes the Higher Education Academic Scholarship Program, percentile qualification standards, public service and medical leave deferments, and transfer rules.

headings.title: Definitions for dual credit certification
headings.reviewNote: Defines approved dual credit provider, approved dual enrollment provider, board, department, dual credit courses, and dual enrollment course.

headings.title: Annual dual credit provider application requirements
headings.reviewNote: Requires higher education institutions to apply annually to the board identifying course locations, offerings, and per-credit fees.

headings.title: Department application review and advertisement prohibition
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to review applications, permits compliance investigations, and prohibits advertising a dual credit course as board-approved without board approval.

headings.title: Public listing of approved dual credit providers
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department to maintain and publish a public listing of approved dual credit providers.

headings.title: Rulemaking and provider certification fees
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes board rulemaking and certification fees to cover certification costs under chapter 536, subject to the August 28, 2016 nonseverability clause.

headings.title: Creation of Dual Credit Certification Fund
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the nonreverting Dual Credit Certification Fund in the state treasury to finance certification operations.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes annual provider certification, advertising prohibitions, application fees, and a dedicated fund for high school dual credit courses.

headings.title: Title of dual credit scholarship act
headings.reviewNote: Cites the statutory section as the Dual Credit and Dual Enrollment Scholarship Act.

headings.title: Student dual credit scholarship eligibility criteria
headings.reviewNote: Establishes citizenship, residency, provider enrollment, 2.5 high school GPA, and economic need criteria for scholarship eligibility.

headings.title: Creation of scholarship and rulemaking authority
headings.reviewNote: Creates the dual credit scholarship program to assist high school students and authorizes board rulemaking.

headings.title: Scholarship award equal to tuition and fees
headings.reviewNote: Provides, subject to appropriation, that each eligible student shall be offered a scholarship equal to tuition and fees paid for dual credit or dual enrollment courses at an approved provider.

headings.title: Establishment of dual credit scholarship fund
headings.reviewNote: Creates the nonreverting Dual Credit and Dual Enrollment Scholarship Fund in the state treasury.

entries.reviewSummary: Creates the Dual Credit and Dual Enrollment Scholarship Act to assist eligible high school students with tuition and fees.

headings.title: Title of Fifteen to Finish Act
headings.reviewNote: Cites the statutory section as the 15 to Finish Act.

headings.title: Policies promoting on-time degree completion
headings.reviewNote: Directs the coordinating board, with public institutions, to develop on-time completion policies defining credential timelines, providing senior-year financial incentives for eight-semester graduation, and reducing degree credit hours where feasible.

headings.title: Reporting on on-time completion incentives
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department to submit a report to the governor and general assembly by December 1, 2017, detailing implementation actions.

entries.reviewSummary: Enacts the 15 to Finish Act directing statewide policies and reporting to encourage on-time undergraduate degree completion.

headings.title: Title of Guided Pathways to Success Act
headings.reviewNote: Cites the section as the Guided Pathways to Success Act.

headings.title: Definitions for guided pathways pilot program
headings.reviewNote: Defines degree maps, meta-majors, proactive advising, and structured schedule for guided pathways programs.

headings.title: Guided pathways to success pilot program development
headings.reviewNote: Directs the board to develop a guided pathways pilot program incorporating semester course maps, transfer pathways, and advising.

headings.title: Department publication of guided pathways materials
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department to maintain public materials explaining guided pathways components to students.

headings.title: Reporting on pilot program educational outcomes
headings.reviewNote: Mandates a report on pilot program outcomes to the governor and general assembly by January 1, 2020.

headings.title: Institutional competitive grants for statewide implementation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes requests for funding to provide competitive implementation grants to higher education institutions based on pilot outcomes.

headings.title: Administrative rulemaking for competitive grants
headings.reviewNote: Directs the board to promulgate rules establishing criteria and procedures for awarding competitive guided pathways grants.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes the Guided Pathways to Success Act pilot program, public student guidance materials, and institutional competitive grants.

headings.title: Definition of concurrent postsecondary enrollment
headings.reviewNote: Defines concurrent postsecondary enrollment as coordinated enrollment in coursework at both a four-year and two-year institution simultaneously.

headings.title: Establishment of concurrent enrollment pilot program
headings.reviewNote: Directs the board to establish a concurrent enrollment pilot program between four-year and two-year institutions to streamline degree completion.

headings.title: Reporting on concurrent enrollment pilot outcomes
headings.reviewNote: Requires the board to report pilot outcomes and recommendations on statewide expansion to the governor and legislature by January 1, 2020.

entries.reviewSummary: Creates a concurrent postsecondary enrollment pilot program between two-year and four-year institutions and requires outcome reporting.

headings.title: Establishment of Kids' Chance Scholarship Program
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the Kids' Chance Scholarship Program for children of workers killed or seriously injured in compensable work-related accidents.

headings.title: Applicability of general statutory definitions
headings.reviewNote: Incorporates definitions from section 173.205 for administration of the Kids' Chance scholarship program.

headings.title: Department administration and recipient selection
headings.reviewNote: Designates the department as the administrative agency to promulgate rules and select recipients considering recommendations from Kids' Chance Inc.

headings.title: Student eligibility criteria for Kids' Chance
headings.reviewNote: Sets age limits between seventeen and twenty-two, state citizenship, parent injury qualification, enrollment, and financial need criteria.

headings.title: Institutional transfer and refund remittance rules
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes institutional transfers without loss of eligibility and directs institutions to remit unused scholarship refunds to the department.

headings.title: Limitation to state-appropriated program moneys
headings.reviewNote: Limits sections 173.254 to 173.258 to state moneys received pursuant to section 173.258 and excludes moneys received from non-state sources.

headings.title: Calculation of maximum scholarship award amount
headings.reviewNote: Limits scholarships to actual tuition charged or resident tuition charged at the University of Missouri, whichever is less.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority under administrative procedures act
headings.reviewNote: Requires all administrative rules promulgated under the section to comply with chapter 536.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes the Kids' Chance Scholarship Program providing higher education scholarships for children of workers killed or injured on the job.

headings.title: Establishment of Fast Track workforce incentive grant
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the Fast Track Workforce Incentive Grant to provide financial assistance for Missouri citizens attending approved postsecondary programs.

headings.title: Definitions for Fast Track grant program
headings.reviewNote: Incorporates section 173.1102 definitions and defines 15 program terms including active apprentice status, eligible apprentice, eligible apprenticeship, eligible program of study, eligible student, eligible training provider, qualifying employment, and related educational costs; source notes section 173.2554 was repealed by S.B. 672, 2022, and 'provision' appears in original rolls.

headings.title: Standards of eligibility for renewed assistance
headings.reviewNote: Applies initial eligibility standards to renewed assistance, except renewal students must demonstrate a 2.5 grade point average on a four-point scale or equivalent.

headings.title: Expiration events for grant eligibility
headings.reviewNote: Specifies expiration of grant eligibility upon obtaining a baccalaureate degree, completing four semesters, or reaching two hundred percent of program duration.

headings.title: Designation of qualifying programs of study
headings.reviewNote: Directs the board to designate eligible programs of study in occupational areas facing workforce shortages.

headings.title: Coordinating board administration of grant program
headings.reviewNote: Designates the coordinating board as administrative agency to establish forms, deadlines, and recipient payment methods.

headings.title: Annual application and renewal determinations
headings.reviewNote: Directs the board to determine renewal eligibility via annual applications and permits requiring applicant and spouse consent for Department of Revenue comparison with prior-year Missouri income tax returns.

headings.title: Award amounts for tuition, fees, and apprenticeships
headings.reviewNote: Sets awards at actual tuition and general fees less other governmental nonloan aid, provides up to $500 or remaining cost of attendance per term if reduced to zero, and covers related educational costs for eligible apprentices.

headings.title: Priority funding rules for program renewal applicants
headings.reviewNote: Requires that renewal students and apprentices receive priority until available funds are expended whenever appropriated funds are insufficient.

headings.title: Institutional transfer and tuition refund remittances
headings.reviewNote: Permits recipients to transfer among approved institutions or eligible training providers without losing eligibility, with award adjustments, and requires institutions to remit grant-attributable refunds to the board for additional awards.

headings.title: Proof of residency and qualifying employment
headings.reviewNote: Requires grant recipients to submit proof of Missouri residency and qualifying employment within thirty days of completing each twelve months of employment until the three-year obligation is fulfilled.

headings.title: Application of Missouri Sunset Act provisions
headings.reviewNote: Applies the Missouri Sunset Act with automatic sunset on August 28, 2029 unless reauthorized (six years after reauthorization) and section termination on December 31 of the following calendar year (December 31, 2030).

headings.title: Creation of Fast Track incentive grant fund
headings.reviewNote: Creates the dedicated nonreverting Fast Track Workforce Incentive Grant Fund in the state treasury.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority for Fast Track grants
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes coordinating board administrative rulemaking under chapter 536 to implement grant provisions.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes the Fast Track Workforce Incentive Grant program, high-demand credential and apprenticeship eligibility, three-year residency and employment reporting, sunset provisions, and a dedicated fund.

headings.title: Collection and distribution of program funds
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to collect and distribute Kids' Chance scholarship funds while prohibiting distribution of the section 173.258 corpus and permitting distribution of accrued interest after the second Monday in October 2008.

headings.title: Creation of Kids' Chance Scholarship Fund
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the Kids' Chance Scholarship Fund in the state treasury from section 173.258 deposits, appropriations, federal funds, and donations, with fund balances transferring to the section 287.690 workers' compensation fund upon termination.

headings.title: Administration and investment of fund moneys
headings.reviewNote: Directs the state treasurer to administer the fund and credit all interest to it, with moneys used solely upon appropriation by the department for carrying out its duties under the section.

headings.title: Exemption from biennial general revenue transfer
headings.reviewNote: Exempts unexpended balances in the fund from lapsing or transferring to the general revenue fund under section 33.080.

entries.reviewSummary: Creates and governs treasury administration, investment, and non-lapsing provisions for the Kids' Chance Scholarship Fund.

headings.title: Establishment of Missouri Workforce Development Board
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the Missouri Workforce Development Board formerly known as the Missouri workforce investment board.

headings.title: Workforce investment purpose and advisory role
headings.reviewNote: Sets the board's purpose to improve workforce quality and productivity through statewide and local workforce systems.

headings.title: Compliance with federal Workforce Innovation Act
headings.reviewNote: Mandates board compliance with the federal Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act or successor federal law.

headings.title: Board composition, gubernatorial appointments, and chairperson
headings.reviewNote: Governs board composition pursuant to federal law, senate confirmation of gubernatorial appointees, and designation of a chairperson.

headings.title: Terms of service and filling of vacancies
headings.reviewNote: Establishes four-year terms of service for board members and provides procedures for filling vacancies.

headings.title: Staggered terms for initial board appointments
headings.reviewNote: Sets staggered initial terms of one, two, three, and four years for members appointed to the board.

headings.title: Expense reimbursement and service without compensation
headings.reviewNote: Provides that board members serve without compensation but receive reimbursement for necessary actual expenses.

headings.title: Website directory of state and local board members
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes department website publication of membership directories and contact information for state and local workforce boards.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes the Missouri Workforce Development Board, board composition under federal WIOA standards, member terms, and expense reimbursements.

headings.title: Adoption of operational bylaws and federal compliance
headings.reviewNote: Directs the board to adopt operating bylaws consistent with statutory provisions and federal WIOA requirements.

headings.title: Quarterly meetings at call of chairperson
headings.reviewNote: Requires the board to meet at least four times each year at the call of the chairperson.

headings.title: Prohibition on service delivery and conflicts of interest
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits the board from directly operating programs and bars members from voting on matters providing direct financial benefits.

headings.title: Amendments to board composition and responsibilities
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes amendments to board roles and responsibilities to comply with successor federal or state legislation.

headings.title: Provision of department staff for board operations
headings.reviewNote: Directs the office of workforce development to provide professional, technical, and clerical staff to support the board.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority and administrative procedure standards
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes board administrative rules under chapter 536 to implement workforce development provisions.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs Missouri Workforce Development Board bylaws, meeting schedules, conflict of interest prohibitions, department staffing, and rulemaking.

headings.title: Board assistance with federal WIOA functions
headings.reviewNote: Directs the workforce development board to assist the governor with statewide workforce development functions under federal WIOA provisions.

headings.title: Annual workforce board activity reporting
headings.reviewNote: Requires the board to submit an annual report of its activities to the governor and legislative leaders by January thirty-first.

headings.title: Reservation of educational authority and jurisdiction
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that the board cannot supersede statutory authority or impose duties on higher education boards or school districts.

entries.reviewSummary: Specifies federal WIOA advisory duties, annual reporting requirements, and jurisdictional boundaries for the workforce development board.

headings.title: Definitions for public safety survivor grants
headings.reviewNote: Defines 15 terms including air ambulance personnel, eligible child, EMT, transportation employee, flight crew, grant, line of duty, public safety officer, permanent and total disability, spouse, and tuition; source notes section 173.205 was repealed by S.B. 389, 2007.

headings.title: Survivor grant awards for tuition and fees
headings.reviewNote: Directs the coordinating board, within appropriations, to provide grants to an eligible child of a public safety officer or transportation employee, or a spouse of a public safety officer, killed or permanently and totally disabled in the line of duty.

headings.title: Program enrollment and degree completion limits
headings.reviewNote: Restricts grants to certificate, associate, or baccalaureate programs, terminates eligibility upon first baccalaureate completion or age 24 for children (through that semester), and caps combined tuition aid at 100 percent of tuition.

headings.title: Coordinating board powers and administration
headings.reviewNote: Directs the coordinating board to promulgate rules, set minimum performance standards, pay tuition grants on recipients' behalf, and provide application forms and procedures.

headings.title: Undergraduate student eligibility and grant amounts
headings.reviewNote: Caps undergraduate grants at the lesser of actual tuition charged at the approved institution or resident full-time tuition at the University of Missouri; source notes section 173.205 was repealed by S.B. 389, 2007.

headings.title: Institutional transfer and refund remittance rules
headings.reviewNote: Allows institutional transfer without loss of entitlement and directs refund remittances to the board upon student withdrawal.

headings.title: Reporting of other student financial aid
headings.reviewNote: Requires institutions and recipients to report all other financial aid received to the coordinating board.

headings.title: Admission and degree completion disclaimer
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that survivor grants do not guarantee institutional admission, continued enrollment, or graduation.

headings.title: Grants for disabled public safety officers
headings.reviewNote: Extends grant eligibility to a public safety officer who is permanently and totally disabled.

headings.title: Termination of eligibility when disability ceases
headings.reviewNote: Terminates grant eligibility for an eligible child, spouse, or public safety officer when the public safety officer or employee is no longer permanently and totally disabled.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes higher education tuition grants for surviving dependents and permanently disabled public safety officers and transportation employees.

headings.title: Establishment of Marguerite Ross Barnett Scholarship
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the Marguerite Ross Barnett Competitiveness Scholarship Program to assist students employed part-time while enrolled.

headings.title: Applicability of definitions and competitiveness scholarship
headings.reviewNote: Applies statutory definitions from section 173.205 and defines competitiveness scholarship as state money paid to a qualified college or university student under the section.

headings.title: Administrative authority and program implementation
headings.reviewNote: Designates the coordinating board as administrative agency to promulgate rules, prescribe application forms, and select recipients.

headings.title: Competitiveness scholarship student eligibility criteria
headings.reviewNote: Establishes eligibility criteria requiring part-time undergraduate status, age eighteen or older, employment of at least twenty hours per week, U.S. citizenship or permanent residency, Missouri residency, and financial need.

headings.title: Institutional transfer and refund remittances
headings.reviewNote: Permits scholarship recipients to transfer between approved Missouri public or private institutions without losing eligibility and requires institutions to remit scholarship-attributable refunds upon withdrawal.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes the Marguerite Ross Barnett Competitiveness Scholarship Program for part-time employed college students.

headings.title: International economic development advisory committee creation
headings.reviewNote: Creates a five-member advisory committee appointed by the economic development director for three-year terms to meet in Jefferson City and review program administration, with an annual report by the director and optional expense reimbursement.

headings.title: Federal, private, and matching state funding
headings.reviewNote: Permits the program to receive federal and private grants, loans, and funding, and authorizes annual general assembly appropriations up to $100,000 not exceeding nongovernmental contributions.

entries.reviewSummary: Creates the International Economic Development Exchange Program Advisory Committee and regulates program funding sources.

headings.title: Title of Public Safety Recruitment Act
headings.reviewNote: Cites the section and section 173.2660 as the Public Safety Recruitment and Retention Act.

headings.title: Definitions for public safety tuition awards
headings.reviewNote: Defines 13 terms including department, firefighter, institution of higher education, legal dependent, line of duty, open seat, police officer, public safety personnel, telecommunicator first responder, and tuition; source notes 'Student Financial Aid' appears in H.B. 419, 2025 original rolls.

headings.title: Tuition award eligibility for public safety personnel
headings.reviewNote: Entitles public safety personnel with at least six years of service and no prior baccalaureate degree, subject to appropriation, to up to 100 percent resident tuition awards for specified license, certificate, associate, or baccalaureate programs.

headings.title: Five-year tuition award eligibility limit for personnel
headings.reviewNote: Limits public safety personnel tuition awards to five consecutive years from initial receipt or achievement of 120 credit hours, whichever occurs first.

headings.title: Tuition award eligibility for legal dependents
headings.reviewNote: Extends tuition awards to legal dependents of public safety personnel with at least ten years of service.

headings.title: Five-year tuition award eligibility limit for dependents
headings.reviewNote: Limits legal dependent tuition awards to five consecutive years from initial receipt or achievement of 120 credit hours, whichever occurs first, while both personnel and dependent remain eligible.

headings.title: Calculation of annual tuition award amounts
headings.reviewNote: Sets awards at up to 100 percent of remaining tuition after federal and state grants, capped for participating approved private institutions at the highest resident tuition and mandatory fees of any Missouri public institution.

headings.title: Application verification and line of duty death
headings.reviewNote: Establishes application verification procedures and preserves dependent eligibility in the event of a line of duty death.

headings.title: Course capacity and open seat limitations
headings.reviewNote: Conditions tuition awards on enrollment in open seats without requiring institutions to create excess program capacity.

headings.title: Application filing deadlines and eligibility notification
headings.reviewNote: Sets a December fifteenth annual application deadline and requires department approval or denial notices by March first.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority and administrative procedure standards
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to promulgate rules under chapter 536 to implement sections 173.2655 and 173.2660, subject to the August 28, 2025 nonseverability clause.

headings.title: Creation of recruitment and retention fund
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the dedicated nonreverting Public Safety Recruitment and Retention Fund in the state treasury.

headings.title: Priority ranking and proration for funding shortfalls
headings.reviewNote: Establishes priority classes based on per capita crime rates and years of service during funding shortfalls.

headings.title: Subject to appropriations contingency requirement
headings.reviewNote: Conditions all tuition awards on available appropriations in the dedicated recruitment and retention fund.

entries.reviewSummary: Enacts the Public Safety Recruitment and Retention Act providing higher education tuition awards for public safety officers and dependents.

headings.title: Five-year residency agreement and loan conversion
headings.reviewNote: Requires legal dependents receiving tuition awards to execute a five-year state residency agreement or face loan conversion with interest serviced by MOHELA.

headings.title: Commencement and conclusion of residency requirement
headings.reviewNote: Defines the timeline for commencement and fulfillment of the five-year Missouri residency requirement.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires dependent tuition award recipients to execute five-year state residency agreements backed by loan conversion terms.

headings.title: Foster care youth tuition and fee waiver
headings.reviewNote: Establishes undergraduate tuition and fee waivers for Missouri residents who were in state foster or residential care.

headings.title: Eligibility criteria, deadlines, and community service
headings.reviewNote: Establishes application deadlines, other aid application rules, board eligibility determinations, and a one hundred hour community service requirement.

headings.title: Annual waiver awards and financial aid offset
headings.reviewNote: Provides annual waiver awards subject to appropriation to reimburse institutions, continues eligibility during good academic standing, and requires institutions to monitor and report community service compliance.

headings.title: Four-year undergraduate waiver duration limit
headings.reviewNote: Limits tuition and fee waivers to four years of undergraduate study and permits use only after other financial aid dedicated solely to tuition and fees is exhausted.

headings.title: Ineligibility of students enrolled as of August 28, 2009
headings.reviewNote: Excludes students already enrolled in an institution of higher education as of August 28, 2009, from waiver eligibility.

headings.title: Administrative rulemaking compliance and invalidity
headings.reviewNote: Governs administrative rulemaking procedures and legislative review requirements under chapter 536.

entries.reviewSummary: Provides undergraduate tuition and fee waivers for youth in state foster care and sets application, community service, and duration limits.

headings.title: Definitions for foreign gift disclosure
headings.reviewNote: Defines foreign government, foreign legal entity, foreign person, gift, and institution of higher education (or institution).

headings.title: Disclosure of foreign gifts and contracts
