headings.reviewNote: Requires public higher education institutions to disclose foreign gifts of $100,000 or more (individually or in aggregate per fiscal year) if any attached term or condition violates or would cause violation of federal or state anti-discrimination laws.

headings.title: Reporting deadline and required disclosure contents
headings.reviewNote: Requires disclosure statements within thirty days after the institution's fiscal year-end detailing gift amounts, dates, conditions, foreign government or country names, purposes, and entity names when academic or policy conditions apply.

headings.title: Public record inspection of foreign gift disclosures
headings.reviewNote: Makes foreign gift disclosures open public records available for inspection and copying during business hours.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires higher education institutions to disclose foreign gifts and contracts exceeding one hundred thousand dollars and provides public record access.

headings.title: Definitions for student athlete likeness compensation
headings.reviewNote: Defines institutional marketing associate, postsecondary educational institution, student athlete, and third party.

headings.title: Institutional rule prohibitions against compensation
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits postsecondary institutions from penalizing student athletes for earning compensation from their name, image, or likeness.

headings.title: Exclusion of grants-in-aid and athletic stipends
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that institutional grants-in-aid and stipends do not constitute compensation under student athlete likeness rules.

headings.title: Contract conflicts, disclosure, institutional role, and unique identifiers
headings.reviewNote: Restricts conflicting apparel and institutional contracts, requires pre-execution contract disclosure, defines institutional assistance limits and non-employee status, restricts direct institutional NIL pay, and governs licensing of unique identifiers.

headings.title: Institutional contract restrictions on athlete compensation
headings.reviewNote: Bars institutional athletic contracts that prevent student athletes from earning likeness compensation during non-team activities.

headings.title: Disclosure of student athlete contract terms
headings.reviewNote: Protects student athlete likeness contract disclosures from public disclosure under open records laws.

headings.title: Performance pay ban, charitable pay, and marketing associates
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits conditioning NIL pay on athletic performance while allowing attendance conditions, permits 501(c)(3) charitable NIL pay, and affirms rights of institutional marketing associates to pay athletes and use institutional marketing capabilities.

headings.title: Required educational workshops for student athletes
headings.reviewNote: Requires institutions entering commercial agreements involving athlete NIL use to offer at least two unique educational workshops per calendar year in different months without marketing or solicitation by financial service providers.

headings.title: Athletic association and conference penalty prohibitions
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits athletic associations and conferences from enforcing rules that penalize student athletes for earning likeness compensation.

headings.title: Student athlete right to professional representation
headings.reviewNote: Guarantees student athletes the right to professional representation without penalty or aid loss, provided representation is by state-licensed attorneys or agents under a written, signed agreement outlining obligations and fees.

headings.title: Civil actions for damages against third parties
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes student athlete civil actions for actual damages and injunctive relief against third parties that violate likeness rights.

headings.title: Legal settlements compliance requirement
headings.reviewNote: Provides that no legal settlement shall conflict with the provisions of the student athlete likeness statute.

headings.title: Applicability to post-enactment agreements and contracts
headings.reviewNote: Applies likeness provisions to agreements entered into, modified, or renewed on or after August 28, 2021.

headings.title: Immunity for institution employees and coaching staff
headings.reviewNote: Protects institution employees and coaching staff from liability for routine intercollegiate athletic decisions.

headings.title: Preservation of student athlete Title IX rights
headings.reviewNote: Affirms that the section does not affect student athletes' rights under Title IX (cited in source text as Education Amendments of 1971, 20 U.S.C. Section 1681 et seq.).

headings.title: High school athlete name and likeness compensation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes high school athletes to negotiate and earn likeness compensation after signing postsecondary commitment agreements.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes statutory protections and standards for college and high school student athlete name, image, and likeness compensation.

headings.title: Authority organizational meeting, officers, and executive director
headings.reviewNote: Provides for the organizational meeting of the higher education loan authority, officer elections, and executive director appointment.

headings.title: Employment of additional authority personnel and compensation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the executive director with authority approval to employ additional staff and fix their compensation.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs organizational meetings, election of officers, executive leadership, and staffing for the Higher Education Loan Authority.

headings.title: Powers of Higher Education Loan Authority
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates authority powers including issuing revenue bonds, purchasing student loans, servicing debt, and entering contracts.

headings.title: Asset distribution to Lewis and Clark Discovery Fund
headings.reviewNote: Directs the authority to distribute three hundred fifty million dollars in assets to the Lewis and Clark Discovery Fund.

headings.title: Immunity of authority members on authorized agreements
headings.reviewNote: Provides personal immunity for authority members lawfully voting on agreements or participating in authorized distributions.

headings.title: State bond ceiling allocation for loan authority
headings.reviewNote: Directs the economic development director, upon the initial $230 million distribution, to allocate a minimum state bond ceiling percentage to the authority for fifteen years, subject to proportional reductions in 2014 through 2021 for undistributed amounts.

entries.reviewSummary: Enumerates statutory powers of the Higher Education Loan Authority and governs asset distributions to the Lewis and Clark Discovery Fund.

headings.title: Creation of Lewis and Clark Discovery Fund
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the nonreverting Lewis and Clark Discovery Fund in the state treasury to support capital projects and research.

headings.title: Permissible appropriations for higher education projects
headings.reviewNote: Restricts annual appropriations to public college and university capital projects (excluding institutions knowingly employing a registered sex offender instructor as of September 1, 2007) and Missouri Technology Corporation technology commercialization and transfer initiatives.

headings.title: Investment of fund moneys by state treasurer
headings.reviewNote: Directs the state treasurer to invest fund moneys, credits earned interest to the fund to reduce MOHELA's section 173.385 payments, and exempts fund balances from biennial reversion under section 33.080.

entries.reviewSummary: Creates the Lewis and Clark Discovery Fund in the state treasury and restricts expenditures to public higher education capital projects and Missouri Technology Corporation commercialization initiatives.

headings.title: Assignment of Community Service Commission to department
headings.reviewNote: Assigns the Missouri Community Service Commission to the Department of Higher Education and Workforce Development.

headings.title: Community service expectation and purpose
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the commission to make community service a common expectation and experience across Missouri.

headings.title: Civic responsibility and volunteer program expansion
headings.reviewNote: Directs the commission to renew civic responsibility and enroll citizens of all ages in community service.

entries.reviewSummary: Assigns the Missouri Community Service Commission to the department and sets forth its civic service missions.

headings.title: Community Service Commission voting membership
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes the composition of fifteen to nineteen voting members appointed by the governor representing community, education, labor, and youth sectors.

headings.title: Nonvoting ex officio commission members
headings.reviewNote: Provides for nonvoting ex officio members representing the Corporation for National and Community Service and other entities.

headings.title: Diversity of commission appointments
headings.reviewNote: Requires commission appointments to reflect statewide demographics regarding race, ethnicity, age, gender, and disability.

headings.title: Terms of service and filling of vacancies
headings.reviewNote: Establishes renewable three-year staggered terms and procedures for filling vacancies.

headings.title: Expense reimbursement and service without compensation
headings.reviewNote: Provides that commission members serve without compensation but receive reimbursement for necessary expenses.

headings.title: Election of commission officers
headings.reviewNote: Directs voting members to elect a chairperson from among themselves and permits electing other necessary officers.

headings.title: Quarterly commission meeting schedule
headings.reviewNote: Requires the community service commission to meet at least quarterly.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs composition, member appointments, term lengths, officer elections, and meeting requirements for the Missouri Community Service Commission.

headings.title: Powers and duties of Community Service Commission
headings.reviewNote: Sets forth commission powers to prepare national service plans, recommend innovative programs, and establish funding priorities.

headings.title: Department staffing and contracting authority
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the commission to utilize department personnel and enter into contracts to execute its service functions.

entries.reviewSummary: Enumerates administrative powers, national service planning responsibilities, and staffing provisions for the Community Service Commission.

headings.title: Agency cooperation and information sharing
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes state agencies, university extension systems, and local governments to share information and cooperate with the commission.

headings.title: State agency community service program coordination
headings.reviewNote: Permits state agencies operating or planning to establish community service programs to coordinate their efforts with the commission.

entries.reviewSummary: Promotes intergovernmental cooperation and service program coordination between state and local agencies and the Community Service Commission.

headings.title: Creation of Community Service Commission Fund
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the nonreverting Community Service Commission Fund in the state treasury to receive appropriations, gifts, and grants.

headings.title: Annual reporting to legislature and governor
headings.reviewNote: Requires the commission to submit an annual activity report to legislative leaders and the governor by January thirty-first.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes the Community Service Commission Fund in the state treasury and mandates annual reporting.

headings.title: Creation of Higher Education Capital Fund
headings.reviewNote: Creates the Higher Education Capital Fund in the state treasury to provide matching funds for institutional capital projects.

headings.title: Matching funds for capital projects and restrictions
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes matching funds for construction and maintenance while prohibiting funds for athletic facilities, parking, or housing.

headings.title: Fifty percent private matching fund requirement
headings.reviewNote: Limits matching distributions to fifty percent of project costs raised through private donations or grants rather than public funds.

headings.title: Application procedures and administrative rulemaking
headings.reviewNote: Directs the commissioner to create an application and establish procedures, and permits rulemaking under chapter 536 subject to the August 28, 2012 nonseverability clause.

headings.title: Fund administration and treasury custody
headings.reviewNote: Assigns fund administration to the commissioner and treasury custody to the state treasurer.

headings.title: Exemption from biennial general revenue transfer
headings.reviewNote: Exempts unexpended balances in the capital fund from reverting to general revenue under section 33.080.

headings.title: Investment of capital fund moneys
headings.reviewNote: Directs the state treasurer to invest capital fund moneys and credit interest earnings to the fund.

headings.title: Definition of public colleges or universities
headings.reviewNote: Defines public colleges or universities for capital matching fund eligibility.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes the Higher Education Capital Fund providing matching state funds for non-housing academic capital projects.

headings.title: Issuance of proprietary school certificates of approval
headings.reviewNote: Directs the coordinating board to issue certificates of approval to proprietary schools meeting statutory minimum standards.

headings.title: Minimum operating and academic standards
headings.reviewNote: Establishes minimum operational standards including curriculum, instructor qualifications, financial responsibility, advertising truthfulness, and records retention.

headings.title: Recognition of regional and national accreditation
headings.reviewNote: Directs the board to accept accreditation by U.S. Department of Education-recognized national or regional agencies as evidence of partial or complete compliance on a school-by-school basis.

headings.title: Reciprocal approval for out-of-state proprietary schools
headings.reviewNote: Permits the board to grant certificates of approval to out-of-state proprietary schools based on reciprocal standards.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes certificate of approval requirements, minimum operational standards, and accreditation recognition for proprietary schools.

headings.title: Annual proprietary school written application
headings.reviewNote: Requires proprietary schools to apply annually for approval, designate principal facilities, and identify franchise locations.

headings.title: Application review and multi-year certification
headings.reviewNote: Provides for department investigations and allows schools in operation for five years to receive two-year certifications.

headings.title: Nontransferability of certificates and ownership changes
headings.reviewNote: Declares certificates nontransferable, requires new applications upon ownership transfers, and authorizes temporary sixty-day certificates.

headings.title: Administrative Hearing Commission appeals
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes administrative appeals to the Administrative Hearing Commission for certificate denials, revocations, or suspensions.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs annual application procedures, multi-year certificates, ownership transfers, and administrative appeals for proprietary schools.

headings.title: Proprietary school certificate base annual fee
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the base annual certificate fee calculation tied to net tuition and fees income, minimum and maximum caps, and CPI-U increases.

headings.title: Rulemaking for additional operational certification fees
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes administrative rules establishing additional fees recommended by the advisory committee to cover program costs.

headings.title: Tuition combination for multi-location schools
headings.reviewNote: Permits schools operating at multiple locations or franchises to combine tuition and fees to calculate annual certification fees.

headings.title: Creation of Proprietary School Certification Fund
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the nonreverting Proprietary School Certification Fund in the state treasury solely to fund certification operations.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes annual fee schedules, inflation adjustments, multi-campus combinations, and the dedicated Proprietary School Certification Fund.

headings.title: Preservation of student defenses against assignees
headings.reviewNote: Subjects school holders and assignees of tuition payment instruments or contracts (other than checks, drafts, or third-party credit card transactions) to all obligor defenses and setoffs.

headings.title: Applicability of uniform commercial code definitions
headings.reviewNote: Applies Uniform Commercial Code definitions from chapter 400 to commercial instruments and rights under the section.

entries.reviewSummary: Preserves student contract defenses and setoffs against assignees of proprietary school tuition obligations.

headings.title: Administration and enforcement by department personnel
headings.reviewNote: Directs the board to administer, supervise, and enforce proprietary school standards through department personnel.

headings.title: Certificates, probation, and surety bond requirements
headings.reviewNote: Requires filing board rules with the secretary of state and authorizes issuing, suspending, or revoking certificates, requiring $5,000-$100,000 security bonds or alternative security, collecting data electronically, reviewing new/revised programs within 90/60 days, and enforcing the act.

headings.title: Student refund and teach-out obligations on school closure
headings.reviewNote: Requires closing, suspended, revoked, or nonrenewed proprietary schools, with board approval, to refund tuition and fees, finish instruction under a temporary certificate, arrange transfer to another school, or implement another board-approved plan.

headings.title: Suspension of rules by joint committee
headings.reviewNote: Provides historical procedures for legislative suspension of proprietary school rules by the joint committee on administrative rules.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs department administration, certificates of approval, surety bonds, program review timelines, and student refund or teach-out obligations for closing proprietary schools.

headings.title: Creation of Proprietary School Advisory Committee
headings.reviewNote: Creates the seven-member Proprietary School Advisory Committee of school owners or managers appointed by the commissioner of higher education for three-year terms, with board designation of initial terms and vacancy appointments.

headings.title: Committee officer election and organization
headings.reviewNote: Directs the advisory committee to organize and elect a chairman and other needed officers.

headings.title: Biannual advisory reporting to coordinating board
headings.reviewNote: Requires the committee to report at least twice annually to advise the coordinating board on proprietary school matters.

headings.title: Advisory responsibilities regarding proprietary standards
headings.reviewNote: Assigns responsibilities to advise the board on administration of sections 173.600 to 173.618, recommend minimum-standard rules, and advise on grievances and complaints.

headings.title: Service without compensation and expense reimbursement
headings.reviewNote: Provides that committee members serve without compensation but may be reimbursed for necessary travel and other expenses from department funds.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes the Proprietary School Advisory Committee, officer selection, advisory responsibilities, and expense reimbursements.

headings.title: Exemptions for public and accredited religious schools
headings.reviewNote: Exempts public higher education institutions, approved private colleges, accredited religious schools, and out-of-state public colleges from proprietary regulation.

headings.title: Exemptions for avocational and apprenticeship programs
headings.reviewNote: Exempts bona fide denominational schools, eleemosynary programs, avocational courses, employer-sponsored training, apprenticeships, and yoga instruction.

headings.title: Exemption for schools licensed under other laws
headings.reviewNote: Exempts schools licensed and approved under other state licensing laws while clarifying corporate filings do not constitute licensing.

headings.title: Voluntary election of proprietary school approval
headings.reviewNote: Permits exempt entities to elect voluntary certification and regulates subsequent return to exempt status.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes statutory exemptions from proprietary school regulation for public, religious, avocational, employer, and apprenticeship programs.

headings.title: Unlawful merchandising practices and board injunctions
headings.reviewNote: Designates violations of proprietary school laws as unlawful practices under consumer protection laws and authorizes board injunctions.

headings.title: Criminal misdemeanor penalty for unauthorized operation
headings.reviewNote: Makes operating a proprietary school without certification or failing to file required surety bonds a class A misdemeanor.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes consumer fraud remedies, injunctive relief, and class A misdemeanor penalties for unauthorized proprietary school operation.

headings.title: Missouri STEM Initiative and matching funds
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the Missouri STEM Initiative within the department to award matching funds to public higher education institutions.

headings.title: Initiative purpose to increase STEM graduates
headings.reviewNote: Sets initiative goals to increase student interest and produce more STEM graduates at Missouri public colleges and universities.

headings.title: Creation of dedicated STEM fund
headings.reviewNote: Creates the nonreverting Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics Fund in the state treasury.

headings.title: Grants for high school articulation agreements
headings.reviewNote: Directs development of grants for articulation agreements between higher education institutions and school districts for IT certification.

headings.title: Legislative appropriations for STEM programs
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes appropriations for endowed professors, student scholarships, experiential youth programs, and teacher career enhancement.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes the Missouri STEM Initiative, dedicated treasury fund, and matching grants for STEM education and faculty endowments.

headings.title: Information technology certification coursework program
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to develop an online IT certification coursework program for high school students earning postsecondary credit.

headings.title: Administrative rulemaking compliance and invalidity
headings.reviewNote: Governs administrative rulemaking procedures and legislative review requirements for IT certification coursework under chapter 536.

entries.reviewSummary: Directs the department to establish an articulated information technology certification program for secondary and postsecondary students.

headings.title: Department study on information technology certificates
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to study the IT industry certifications most frequently requested by Missouri employers and permits assistance from other state agencies, the math and science coalition, and the governor's STEM advisory council.

headings.title: Study completion deadline and report distribution
headings.reviewNote: Requires completing the study by January 31, 2015, and submitting a report of findings to legislative leaders, the joint committee on education, the governor, the coordinating board, and the state board of education.

entries.reviewSummary: Directs the department to conduct and report on a statewide study of the information technology industry certifications most frequently requested by Missouri employers.

headings.title: Definitions for STEM grant program
headings.reviewNote: Defines approved institution, CGPA, department, initial recipient, renewal recipient, satisfactory academic progress, STEM degree, STEM field, and STEM grant ($1,500 renewable award).

headings.title: Annual STEM grant awards and aggregate cap
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department, subject to appropriation, to make STEM grants available to initial or renewal recipients committed to a STEM degree, capped at $6,000 per student.

headings.title: Renewal eligibility and satisfactory academic progress
headings.reviewNote: Requires renewal recipients to maintain a 2.5 GPA, retain Access Missouri eligibility, and observe semester limits.

headings.title: Degree completion limits and semester caps
headings.reviewNote: Precludes STEM grants for Access Missouri recipients after earning a baccalaureate degree, completing hours required for a baccalaureate degree, or completing 150 semester hours or 225 quarter hours.

headings.title: Administrative rulemaking compliance and invalidity
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes department rulemaking under chapter 536 to implement STEM grant provisions.

headings.title: Application of Missouri Sunset Act provisions
headings.reviewNote: Applies the Missouri Sunset Act with automatic sunset six years after August 28, 2025 (August 28, 2031) unless reauthorized (12 years if reauthorized) and termination September 1 of the following year (September 1, 2032).

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes the renewable STEM grant program for undergraduate students enrolled in high-demand science and technology degree fields.

headings.title: Definitions for Pediatric Disease Task Force
headings.reviewNote: Defines genetic disease, pediatric disease, and rare pediatric disease for task force operations.

headings.title: Establishment of Pediatric Disease Task Force
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the Pediatric Disease Task Force within the Department of Higher Education and Workforce Development.

headings.title: Task force membership and gubernatorial appointments
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes task force membership including agency heads, legislative appointees, university representatives, and research industry experts.

headings.title: Quarterly meetings and departmental clerical support
headings.reviewNote: Directs the task force to meet quarterly beginning in 2027 with clerical support provided by the department.

headings.title: Annual report on pediatric research initiatives
headings.reviewNote: Requires an annual public report by December thirty-first detailing institutional research initiatives, outcomes, expenditures, and recommendations.

headings.title: Statutory expiration date for task force
headings.reviewNote: Provides that the pediatric disease task force section expires on December 31, 2030.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes the Pediatric Disease Task Force to coordinate and report on institutional research initiatives for rare pediatric diseases.

headings.title: Governor term on Midwestern Higher Education Commission
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that the governor serves on the Midwestern Higher Education Commission concurrently with the gubernatorial term.

headings.title: Legislative member terms on commission
headings.reviewNote: Establishes two-year terms for members of the house of representatives and senate serving on the commission.

headings.title: At-large member terms on commission
headings.reviewNote: Establishes four-year terms for at-large members and terminates membership upon leaving the field of higher education or state.

headings.title: Filling of commission vacancies
headings.reviewNote: Provides procedures for filling unexpired commission vacancies by gubernatorial appointment with senate consent.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs terms of service and vacancy filling for Missouri members of the Midwestern Higher Education Commission.

headings.title: Annual high school graduate performance reporting
headings.reviewNote: Directs the board to establish procedures for reporting the performance of public high school graduates in their first year of public college.

headings.title: High school reporting procedures and data privacy
headings.reviewNote: Requires data disaggregated by race and sex grouped by high school, while protecting individual student identities and small cohorts.

headings.title: Report metrics on GPA, retention, and remediation
headings.reviewNote: Specifies reporting metrics including initial college grade point average, semester retention rates, and noncollege remedial enrollment.

headings.title: Department review of remedial education policies
headings.reviewNote: Requires the Department of Elementary and Secondary Education to review remedial education policies and present results to the joint committee on education by October 31, 2017; source notes subdivision (6) was renumbered to (7) under section 3.060.

entries.reviewSummary: Directs annual performance and remediation reporting on high school graduates attending Missouri public colleges and universities.

headings.title: Unlawful use of false academic degrees
headings.reviewNote: Makes it unlawful to knowingly use or attempt to use false or misleading higher education degrees for admission, employment, trade, or public office.

headings.title: Criteria defining false or misleading degrees
headings.reviewNote: Defines false or misleading degrees including uncompleted requirements, impersonation, or degrees granted in violation of law.

headings.title: Class C misdemeanor penalty for degree fraud
headings.reviewNote: Establishes a class C misdemeanor criminal penalty for fraudulent use of academic degrees.

headings.title: Definition of coordinating board for higher education
headings.reviewNote: Defines board as the Coordinating Board for Higher Education for degree fraud enforcement.

entries.reviewSummary: Prohibits fraudulent use of false or misleading academic degrees and establishes class C misdemeanor criminal penalties.

headings.title: Title of Advantage Missouri Program
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the statutory title of the Advantage Missouri Program providing loans and loan forgiveness for high-demand occupations.

headings.title: Creation of Advantage Missouri Trust Fund
headings.reviewNote: Creates the nonreverting Advantage Missouri Trust Fund in the state treasury consisting of appropriations, donations, and loan repayments.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes the Advantage Missouri Program and dedicated treasury trust fund for student loans in high-demand occupations.

headings.title: Contractual terms for loan participation and forgiveness
headings.reviewNote: Requires written contracts covering repayment, zero interest during full-time or board-approved part-time enrollment, forgiveness terms, appropriation and high-demand job contingencies, and penalties; source notes word 'the' does not appear in original rolls.

headings.title: Appropriations condition for loan program contracts
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that the board is not required to enter into loan contracts when program funds are unavailable.

entries.reviewSummary: Prescribes mandatory contract terms, loan forgiveness conditions, and appropriation contingencies for Advantage Missouri loans.

headings.title: Definition of taxpayer for trust fund contributions
headings.reviewNote: Defines taxpayer including individuals, partnerships, corporations, and charitable entities for Advantage Missouri contributions.

headings.title: Tax credit for contributions to trust fund
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes chapter 143 income tax credits (excluding withholding taxes under sections 143.191 to 143.265) of up to 50 percent of contributions to the fund, capped at $100,000 per taxpayer.

headings.title: Department of Revenue administration and annual cap
headings.reviewNote: Directs the Department of Revenue to administer tax credits up to a five million dollar annual statewide cap.

headings.title: Ten-year tax credit carryforward allowance
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes carryforward of unused tax credits for up to ten succeeding tax years until fully claimed.

headings.title: Prohibition on tax credits after 2005
headings.reviewNote: Sunsets tax credit awards under the section for all tax years beginning on or after January 1, 2005.

headings.title: Effective date of tax credit provisions
headings.reviewNote: Sets the section's original effective date as January 1, 1999; source notes the 2007 amended version took effect November 28, 2007.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes tax credits for contributions to the Advantage Missouri Trust Fund, carryforward rules, and tax year 2005 sunset.

headings.title: Definitions for Workforce Diploma Program
headings.reviewNote: Defines 26 program terms including academic skill intake assessment, accredited, adult dropout recovery services, approved program provider, career pathways coursework, cohort, department, employability skills certification, milestones, stackable credential, and student.

headings.title: Establishment of Workforce Diploma Program
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the Workforce Diploma Program within the Department of Elementary and Secondary Education for adult learners.

headings.title: Annual request for qualifications for providers
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to issue annual requests for qualifications for adult education providers meeting statutory operating standards.

headings.title: Announcement and authorization of approved providers
headings.reviewNote: Requires annual announcement of approved providers before October sixteenth with enrollment authorization before November fifteenth, and allows approved providers to maintain approval without annual reapplication unless removed.

headings.title: Provider credit accounting and academic alignment
headings.reviewNote: Requires approved program providers to comply with department requirements ensuring accurate accounting of accumulated and remaining diploma credits and coursework aligned to state academic performance standards.

headings.title: Milestone payment schedules for completed credentials
headings.reviewNote: Establishes department-set milestone payments for half-unit credits, certifications, tiered credentials, and diplomas subject to appropriation, while barring duplicate funding and student fees except for optional extra education.

headings.title: Monthly invoicing, payment order, and status updates
headings.reviewNote: Requires monthly provider invoices before the eleventh calendar day, department payment in order received until funds are exhausted, and monthly written funding and enrollment updates by the last calendar day.

headings.title: Annual provider performance metric reporting
headings.reviewNote: Mandates annual cohort-by-cohort provider reporting before July sixteenth on funded students, credits earned, certifications, tiered credentials, graduates, average cost per graduate, and graduation rate.

headings.title: Annual post-graduation cohort outcome surveys
headings.reviewNote: Directs approved providers to submit annual cohort surveys before September sixteenth for five consecutive post-graduation years covering employment status, hourly wages, employer-sponsored health care, and postsecondary enrollment.

headings.title: Department performance reviews, probation, and removal
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department beginning at the end of the second fiscal year to review providers against a 50 percent graduation rate and $7,000 cost-per-graduate cap, placing noncompliant providers on probation and removing those failing two consecutive years.

headings.title: Nondiscrimination and adult basic education referrals
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits approved providers from discriminating based on listed protected characteristics and permits referring students to state adult basic education services when better served there.

headings.title: Creation of Workforce Diploma Program Fund
headings.reviewNote: Creates the dedicated nonreverting Workforce Diploma Program Fund in the state treasury.

headings.title: Director rulemaking authority for program administration
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the department director to promulgate administrative rules to implement the workforce diploma program.

headings.title: Severability clause for program provisions
headings.reviewNote: Provides that if any provision or application of the section is held invalid, the remainder remains in full effect.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes the Workforce Diploma Program providing performance-based funding for adult high school completion and workforce credentials.

headings.title: Title of Career-Tech Certificate Program
headings.reviewNote: Cites the statutory section as the Career-Tech Certificate (CTC) Program.

headings.title: Definitions for Career-Tech Certificate Program
headings.reviewNote: Defines approved institution, department, eligible program of study, eligible student, eligible training provider, and training program (including CNA, CMT, L1MA, insulin administration, EMT, AEMT, paramedic, and CDL programs).

headings.title: Establishment of Career-Tech Certificate Program
headings.reviewNote: Directs reimbursement rules beginning in 2026-27, caps private/virtual/training provider tuition reimbursements at community college rates, requires prior department authorization (20-business-day review) for overlapping public-region programs, and bars unconstitutional reimbursements.

headings.title: Creation of Career-Tech Certificate Program Fund
headings.reviewNote: Creates the nonreverting Career-Tech Certificate (CTC) Program Fund in the state treasury.

headings.title: Ban on disqualifying non-Title IV or short programs
headings.reviewNote: Bars department rules from disqualifying students from state tuition reimbursement solely because a program does not meet 34 CFR 668.8 length requirements or the training provider does not participate in federal student aid.

headings.title: Expiration events for reimbursement eligibility
headings.reviewNote: Terminates tuition, books, and fees reimbursement eligibility upon receipt for the required program length, successful program completion, or reaching 150 percent of usual program completion time, whichever occurs first.

headings.title: Administrative rulemaking compliance and invalidity
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes department rulemaking under chapter 536 to implement and administer the career-tech program.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes the Career-Tech Certificate Program to reimburse tuition, books, and fees for students in career and technical education.

headings.title: Title of Returning Heroes' Education Act
headings.reviewNote: Cites the statutory section as the Missouri Returning Heroes' Education Act.

headings.title: Definition of combat veteran for educational benefits
headings.reviewNote: Defines combat veteran through combat theater, medal, or hostile fire documentation, honorable discharge, and Missouri voter eligibility or current residency.

headings.title: Undergraduate tuition limitation for combat veterans
headings.reviewNote: Caps undergraduate tuition charged to combat veterans at fifty dollars per credit hour for ten years following discharge upon maintaining a 2.5 GPA.

headings.title: Graduate degree tuition limitation for combat veterans
headings.reviewNote: Limits combat veteran graduate tuition to 30 percent of tuition and fees for twenty years post-discharge for master's and doctoral degrees, excluding professional degrees such as law, medicine, or veterinary medicine.

headings.title: Coordinating board enforcement and rulemaking authority
headings.reviewNote: Directs the coordinating board to ensure institutional compliance and authorizes administrative rules.

headings.title: Application order of federal and state student aid
headings.reviewNote: Allows combat veterans to apply the tuition limitation before federal and state aid and requires signed institutional notice.

headings.title: Institutional waiver reporting and state reimbursement
headings.reviewNote: Permits institutions to report waived tuition and authorizes legislative reimbursement appropriations, while clarifying that lack of reimbursement appropriations does not deny combat veterans the tuition limitation.

headings.title: Administrative rulemaking compliance and invalidity
headings.reviewNote: Governs administrative rulemaking procedures and legislative review requirements for combat veteran tuition limitations under chapter 536.

entries.reviewSummary: Enacts the Missouri Returning Heroes' Education Act capping undergraduate and graduate tuition rates for combat veterans at public institutions.

headings.title: Title and definitions for Textbook Transparency Act
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the Textbook Transparency Act and defines adopter, approved institution of higher education, college textbook, integrated textbook, products, and supplemental material.

headings.title: Publisher disclosure of textbook pricing and revisions
headings.reviewNote: Requires textbook publishers upon request to disclose wholesale bookstore prices, substantive content revisions, copyright history, and alternative formats.

headings.title: Requirement to offer unbundled textbooks and supplements
headings.reviewNote: Requires publishers selling bundled textbooks and supplemental materials to offer each item separately and individually priced.

headings.title: Campus bookstore financial aid voucher policies
headings.reviewNote: Directs public higher education institutions where feasible to allow students to use undisbursed financial aid to purchase textbooks at campus stores.

headings.title: Early textbook ordering and buyback coordination
headings.reviewNote: Encourages faculty to place textbook orders early to facilitate bookstore buybacks, check availability, and lower student costs.

entries.reviewSummary: Enacts the Textbook Transparency Act regulating publisher disclosures, unbundling requirements, and campus bookstore financial aid policies.
